title: 第16章 过往第17章 息火
lines: 漫天杀意席卷整个斩仙天宫，财多多直接双脚一踏冲天而起飞向斩仙殿，就在快到仙殿时一阵玄妙之光闪过
财多多直接消失在半空
"封仙界…"
财多多望着周围环境一变的天地知道自己被拉入封仙域的封仙罚罪道兵之中了
突然一道道光线自天空之上射出直奔财多多而来，后面还有无数人影一道道浮现
光线瞬间洞穿财多多，只见他的气息不断削弱，身上露出些许白骨
他死死的盯着天空中的人影
"你们这群跳梁小丑，把人给我放了"
刀意傍身，财多多持刀一划，天地撑不住刀息露出一道道碎痕
空中为首之人乃是一名金衣女子，她向前一踏，手中一抚顿时她的身侧出现一大堆凡人还有一些下枢三四境的低阶修士
财多多瞳孔一缩，手中斩刀松了一些，浑身杀意也消散不少，他望向为首女子
"疯…夏怜前辈，不知你是何意，我记得公子临走前可是好好警告过你的"
女子闻言平静的脸色露出一丝冷笑
"财多多，一直以来你都在阻碍我，少拿那个男人说事，说不定他都死外边了！"女子似乎想到什么立马大声怒吼
"把斩仙刀交给我，我就放人"
财多多露出冷笑，摇了摇头嘲讽道:
"给你能怎么样，没有我的血脉没有人能催动它"
"这就不是你关心的事了"
"你先放人"
"你先放刀"
双方僵持不下，但是财多多突然放下手中斩刀，目露凶光道:
"你先放一半过来"
女子露出犹豫之色，随即点头，她立马一推一半人群就飘向财多多，财多多立马将人群往身后一藏，然后冲天杀意迸发
"小爷从不把刀交给别人，我能救一半，剩下的就拿你们给他们陪葬，今天小爷…"
财多多话音戛然而止，望向了身后，以及身后刺向他心脏的一柄尖刀
他单膝跪地一脸茫然的望着面前熟悉的脸庞，人群似乎也乱起来
"风叔你在干什么，你疯了！"
"风老头，你良心让狗吃了"
"风叔…"财多多的心脏处开始不断变黑，尖刀上充满着诡异的气息在蚕食他的法源
"能告诉我为什么吗…"
风叔脸上露出愧疚之色，神色悲伤
"我…没有办法"
content_en:
The sky full of murderous intent swept through the entire Immortal Beheading Palace. Cai Duoduo directly stepped into the sky with his feet and took off towards the Immortal Beheading Palace. Just as he was approaching the Immortal Beheading Palace, a mysterious light flashed across the sky.
Caiduoduo disappeared directly into the air
"Sealing Immortal Realm..."
Cai Duoduo looked at the changing world around him and knew that he had been pulled into the Immortal Punishment Taoist soldiers of the Immortal Realm.
Suddenly, rays of light shot out from the sky and headed straight towards Caiduoduo, with countless figures appearing behind them.
The light instantly penetrated Cai Duoduo, and his aura was constantly weakening, and some bones were exposed on his body.
He stared at the figure in the sky
"You clowns, let me go"
The sword is close to his body, Cai Duoduo cuts it with the sword, the world cannot hold the breath of the sword, revealing a series of broken marks
The leader in the air was a woman in golden clothes. She stepped forward and touched her hand. Suddenly, a large number of mortals and some low-level monks from the third and fourth realms appeared beside her.
Cai Duoduo's pupils shrank, the chopping knife in his hand relaxed a little, and the murderous intention in his body also dissipated a lot, he looked at the leading woman
"Crazy...Senior Xia Lian, I don't know what you mean. I remember that the young master gave you a good warning before he left."
The woman's calm face revealed a sneer after hearing this.
"Cai Duoduo, you have been hindering me all this time, stop talking about that man, maybe he will die outside!" The woman seemed to have thought of something and immediately roared loudly.
"Give me the Immortal Killing Sword and I will release you."
Cai Duoduo sneered, shook his head and mocked:
"What can I do to you? Without my blood, no one can activate it."
"That's not your concern anymore"
"You let me go first"
"You put the knife first"
The two sides were in a stalemate, but Cai Duoduo suddenly put down his chopping knife and said with a fierce look:
"Put half of it over first."
The woman showed hesitation, then nodded. She immediately pushed half of the crowd and floated towards Cai Duoduo. Cai Duoduo immediately hid the crowd behind him, and then burst out with murderous intent.
"I never give my knife to others. I can save half of them, and you will bury the rest with them. Today, I..."
"呲"
Cai Duoduo's words stopped abruptly and he looked behind him, as well as the sharp knife stabbing his heart behind him.
"Bang"
He knelt down on one knee and stared blankly at the familiar face in front of him, and the crowd seemed to be in chaos.
"Uncle Feng, what are you doing? You are crazy!"
"Old man Feng, your conscience has been eaten by dogs."
"Uncle Feng..." Cai Duoduo's heart began to turn black, and the sharp knife was filled with a strange aura that was eating away at his magic source.
"Can you tell me why..."
Uncle Feng had a guilty look on his face and looked sad.
"I...have no choice"
